title: Use the customer tables on a phone

steps.do: Open Customers on a phone (or DevTools at 390 px).
steps.expect: Title and number on one line, the toolbar under it on the same strip, the table reaching the screen edges, the footer pinned at the bottom with Prev / 'Page 1 of N' / Next. No sideways page scroll.
steps.note: title 'Customers' + count '772' same line=true; toolbar under=true; table scroller x 0..390 with 16px inset (rows scroll sideways under the gutter to both screen edges), table x 16..738; footer 'Previous Page 1 of 39 Next' at y 710..756 of 844; horizontal page overflow 0px

steps.expect: Filters open as a bottom sheet; applying a filter adds a chip under the bar.
steps.note: sheet y 394..844 ('Filter and sort FILTERS PIPELINE Any CREATED Pick dates SORT Created ROWS PER PA…'); closed via Close; chips ["Pipeline: Leads"] at y 127 (search bar y 69); url /dashboard/customers?pc_pipeline=leads

steps.do: Tap a row's ⋯ (always visible on phone) → Schedule Meeting, then close.
steps.expect: The 'New meeting — <name>' modal fits the screen and closes cleanly.
steps.note: ⋯ opacity 1; modal 'New meeting — Grant Nakagawa' box x 0..390, y 0..844 (viewport 390×844); page overflow 0px; closed=true

steps.expect: The empty state fills the table area; no footer.
steps.note: body 'No customers No customers match these filters' y 174..756; footer=false

steps.do: Open Lead Sources, tap a source, then the back button.
steps.expect: The source's customers pane (Customer, Pipeline, Created) fits the width; back returns to the source list. Agent saw: at 390 px the pane's table is 562 px wide, so Created is off-screen until you swipe sideways inside it, and about 2 rows show. Judge whether that's acceptable.
steps.note: pane columns Customer|Pipeline|Created; table frame x 32..594; page overflow 0px; back → list visible=true (url /dashboard/lead-sources). Worth a look: the pane table is 562 px wide in a 358 px pane, so Created (and half of Pipeline) sit off-screen and need a sideways swipe inside the table; only ~2 rows show above the footer at 390×844 because the source header takes the top half.

steps.expect: Same strip and table layout as Customers.
steps.note: title/count same line, toolbar under, body x 16..374, footer y 710 (customers 710), search y 69 (customers 69), overflow 0px

why: The customers page and both lead-source panes now lay out through DataView.Bar/Body instead of RecordsPageShell and hand-written wrappers (5e97899c8, 49787b7b8); the empty state now replaces the whole table, footer included (7e179f51e).
note: F8.2: the Created column is off-screen until I swipe
